name: Xero API
summary: Access invoices, bank feeds, payroll summaries, and financial reports from Xero.
whatItDoes: Connects to Xero accounting for SMBs outside the US-heavy QuickBooks ecosystem — pulls AR/AP, P&L, cash summaries, and payroll-related journal data for forecasting workflows.
privacyNotes: Financial and payroll-adjacent data requires strict OAuth scoping and encrypted storage. Read-only access is recommended for planning workflows.
